title: Colours blend really well and looks great
text: Colours blend really well and looks great. I love this curtain. It actually looks better than the picture. For my bathroom, since it has a very almond like colour it looked perfect! I think its really nice although it is quite long, it ended up being just a little longer than I expected but I like it anyway and it looks great :) Makes the room look bigger and brighter in my opinion. Great choice.
